title: Thiruppavai - 04 - Aazhi mazhaik kannaa - Varali - Adi - AnDAL
name: Thiruppavai

sections.title: Lyrics
lyrics: Aazhi mazhaik kannaa onru nee kai karavael
Oozhi mudhalvan uruvam pol mEi karuththup
Aazhi pol minni valamburi pol ninru adhirndhu
Aa zhi pol min ni va lam bu ri pol nin ru adhirndhu
thA zhA dhE sArn gam u dhai tha sa ra ma zhai pol
vA zhA u la gi nil pEi dhi dAi naan ga Lum
mAr ga zhi nee rA da ma gizh dhE lor yEm pA vAi
